label: De Eendracht (1990, P. Lieftinckstraat) narrow terraced house: low front eaves with a teal fascia over a mottled grey-beige brick ground storey and dark navy plinth, teal door beside a grey panel, wide window under a white render panel, and a white two-storey box (wall dormer) rising from the eaves over the window half, joined with the mirrored neighbour's

dormers.note: white rendered box rising from the eaves over the window half, flush with the wall, joined at the party wall with the mirrored neighbour's box; 2-light window 2.6-4.1 m from the door side, sill ~3.8 m, then a brick pier to the party wall (2123280, 2082250, 2107835)

chimneys.note: black vent pipes on the front slope near the ridge, over the door half

box.label: grey-beige mottled brick, white box, teal door and fascia

notes: Roof: roof-colours.ts reads the orthophoto #8c8c84 over the 30 placed houses; the shaded street view reads dark grey-brown; drawn #696463 between the two.

Two storeys (the kit minimum; every front element stands on the ground storey line, so the 1.8 m storey split does not show) up to the low front eaves (pinned at the photographed 3.6 m: 3DBAG's eaves reads the box tops on some houses); the upper rooms live under the roof and in the white box, drawn as a flush wall dormer (setBackM 0) whose window stops 0.54 m short of the party wall (DormerSpec.marginEndM, #77) so the paired boxes show two windows with a pier between them, as photographed. The pier is drawn in the box's white, not brick.
The teal fascia board over the door half is not expressible (the eaves edge is drawn in the roof tile). Rear dormers and the brick front-garden walls are not modelled.
North fronts photographed in shade: colours white-referenced to the white render of the same crop. Terrace #53 was photographed from the garden side only and is not staged.
